objectives.summary: The project aims to develop a web application for video communication that is compatible with modern browsers and includes features such as screen sharing, video recording, and mobile versions for various platforms. The overall goal is to enhance user communication capabilities, including options for audio communication and user registration, while targeting tech support companies and recruiters as the primary market.
key_points: The project aims to create a web application for video communication that works on almost all modern browsers.
The project plans to add a screen sharing option for technical support.
The project aims to create a version for mobile devices (Android, iOS, Windows) and publish them in corresponding stores.
The project will allow user registration, but users can also use the service without registration.
The target market includes tech support companies and recruiters.
The application will be offered for free, with options for ads and an ad-free paid version.
